title: The Xiao Clan Attacked
summary: Masked attackers storm the Xiao Clan in Wu Tan City and toy with Xiao Zhan, who keeps standing so his people can escape. In a tavern, Xiao Yan hears that his duel is the talk of the empire and that the Xiao Clan is in trouble. He rushes home, refusing Medusa's demand to stop for herbs. At the Misty Cloud Sect, Yun Yun tells Yun Shan she sensed a presence full of death on her way back. In Wu Tan City, Ao Ba Pa and the alchemist teacher of Liu Xi try to force the weakened Xiao Clan to sell its market. Xiao Yan arrives, and Medusa, given a Tomb Monster Needle Fruit for her help, drives them off. The First Elder of the Xiao Clan then admits that Xiao Zhan is missing.
events: Masked attackers hunt Xiao Zhan; he holds out for an incense stick of time.
Xiao Yan hears in a tavern that 'Yan Xiao' and Xiao Yan are the same and that the Xiao Clan is in trouble.
He turns down Medusa's herb hunt and heads for Wu Tan City.
Yun Yun reports to Yun Shan about a presence of death; Yun Shan then speaks with a hidden figure.
Ao Ba Pa and Liu Xi's teacher (a Six-Star Da Dou Shi) try to take over the Xiao Clan's market.
Xiao Yan arrives; Medusa's appearance sends the enemies fleeing.
The First Elder apologises; Xiao Zhan is missing.
cultivation: Liu Xi's teacher "has the power of a Six-Star Da Dou Shi".
